trails.why: The length of the trail to the lake is 27 km. Vertical set of 1986 ft., descent 1637 ft. Complexity is average.

Molodaya gvardiya summit
trails.why: The Peak of the Young Guards is a mountain peak in Zaily Alatau at an altitude of 4398 meters above sea level. It is located in the Maloalmatian ridge on the territory of the Ile-Alatau national park within the Karaisai district of the Almaty region, Kazakhstan.

trails.name: Almaty summit
trails.why: The Nursultan Peak is a mountain in the Transili Alatau in Kazakhstan.

trails.name: Sovetov summit
trails.why: Peak of Soviets is a mountain peak on the northern slope of the Zayli Altau ridge, dominating the basin of the Great Almaty River and the Great Almaty Lake. It has a correct pyramidal shape, is located between the peak of the Locomotive and the pass...

trails.name: Chkalov summit
trails.why: Chkalov Peak is a mountain peak in the Zayli Altau ridge, located in the Almaty region of Kazakhstan. It is 3892 meters above sea level.

trails.name: Aqsoran summit
trails.why: The slopes are steep, rocky, heavily dismembered. It consists of Permian granites. The highest point of Central Kazakhstan.

trails.name: KazTAG summit
trails.why: Kazakhstan telegraph agency. The first ascent was made in 1939 by D.D. Salanov

trails.name: Turan tiger summit
trails.why: The first climb to the summit is from 31.08.2023. Named after an extinct species of tiger that was recently seen in our mountains.
